blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The government needs to swiftly adopt comprehensive reforms to prevent school shootings following the recent attack at a South Cotabato national high school that left three students dead and several others wounded, according to members of the House minority bloc. In separate statements, Akbayan party-list Reps. Chel Diokno and Percival Cendaña, along with Mamamayang Liberal party-list Rep. Leila de Lima, said the latest incident — this time at the Banga National High School — only reinforces their previous calls for reforms and efforts to make schools safe places.
